# load data in 'global' chunk so it can be shared by all users of the dashboard

library(shinyauthr)
library(shinyBS)

# library(kerasR)
library(png)
library(grid)
library(RSQLite)
library(shinydashboard)
library(glue)
library(readr)
library(imputeTS)
tryCatch({
  source("util.R")
  sql_db_file <<- "exoplanet_db.sqlite"
  processed <<- list.files("trained_models/", full.names = F)
  all_stars <<- list.files("data/", pattern = ".tbl", full.names = F)
  data_dir <<- "data/"
  plots_dir <<- "plots/test_pred_plot/"
}, error = function(e) {
  source("../util.R")
  sql_db_file <<- "../exoplanet_db.sqlite"
  processed <<- list.files("../trained_models/", full.names = F)
  all_stars <<- list.files("../data/", pattern = ".tbl", full.names = F)
  data_dir <<- "../data/"
  plots_dir <<- "../plots/test_pred_plot/"
})

return_stars <- function(processed) {
  processed <- strsplit(processed, "_")
  processed <- unique(sapply(processed, function(filename) filename[1]))
  return(processed)
}

processed <- return_stars(processed)
all_stars <- return_stars(all_stars)
remaining <- setdiff(all_stars, processed)
train_ratio <- 0.7
seq_len <- 128


mydb <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), sql_db_file)
if(!dbExistsTable(conn = mydb, name = "user_star")) {
  dbGetQuery(mydb, "CREATE TABLE user_star (user_id varchar(64), kepler_id int, start int, end int);")
}
if(!dbExistsTable(conn = mydb, name = "user_base")) {
  dbGetQuery(mydb, "CREATE TABLE user_base (user varchar(64), password_hash varchar(101), permissions varchar(9), name varchar(64), PRIMARY KEY(user));")
}


user_base <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
dbDisconnect(mydb)



int1 <- length(processed)
int1 <- (int1 == 0) * 1 + (int1 != 0) * int1
style_text <- paste0("
        #kplr_id ~ .selectize-control .option:nth-child(-n+",
        as.character(int1),
        ") {
          background-color: rgba(0,255,0,1);

        }

        #kplr_id ~ .selectize-control .option:nth-child(n+",
        as.character(int1 + 1),
        ") {
          background-color: rgba(255,0,0,1);
        }

        #login-panel {
          display: block !important;
        }
")
options <- c(processed, remaining)

```{r}
shinyApp(ui = dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(
    title = "Exoplanet Candidates Page",
    tags$li(class = "dropdown", style = "padding: 8px;",
            shinyauthr::logoutUI("logout")),
    tags$li(
      class = "dropdown", 
      tags$a(icon("github"), 
             href = "https://github.com/SNaveenMathew/Unsupervised-Exoplanet",
             title = "See the code on github"))),
  
  dashboardSidebar(collapsed = T,
    div(textOutput("welcome"), style = "padding: 20px"),
    div(uiOutput("kplr_id"))
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    shinyjs::useShinyjs(),
    uiOutput("login_page"),
    tags$head(
      tags$style(style_text)
    ),
    uiOutput("planet_page")
  )
),

server = function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Unified SQLite connection for the session, closed on session end
  db_conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), sql_db_file)
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {
    if(DBI::dbIsValid(db_conn)) {
      DBI::dbDisconnect(db_conn)
    }
  })
  
  logout_init <- shinyauthr::logoutServer(
    id = "logout",
    active = reactive(credentials()$user_auth)
  )
  
  credentials <- shinyauthr::loginServer(
    id = "login", 
    data = user_base,
    user_col = user,
    pwd_col = password_hash,
    sodium_hashed = TRUE,
    log_out = reactive(logout_init())
  )
  
  observe({
    if(credentials()$user_auth) {
      shinyjs::removeClass(selector = "body", class = "sidebar-collapse")
    } else {
      shinyjs::addClass(selector = "body", class = "sidebar-collapse")
    }
  })
  
  output$kplr_id <- renderUI({
    if(credentials()$user_auth) {
      return(selectInput(inputId = "kplr_id", label = "Select Kepler ID:",
                         choices = options, selected = options[1]))
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$signup, {
    refresh <- F
    if(input$user == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Username cannot be blank!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$password == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Password cannot be blank!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$name == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Name cannot be empty!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$name != "" & input$password != "" & input$user != "") {
      current_users <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
      if(input$user %in% current_users$user) {
        output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Username already exists. Please enter a differnet username!<b></font>'))
      } else {
        passwd_hsh <- sodium::password_store(input$password)
        insert_query <- paste0("INSERT INTO user_base VALUES('", input$user, "', '", passwd_hsh, "', '", input$permissions, "', '", input$name, "');")
        dbExecute(db_conn, insert_query)
        output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "green"><b>Signup successful! Please refresh the page before attempting to login<b></font>'))
        refresh <- T
      }
    }
    user_base <<- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
    if(refresh) {
      shinyjs::refresh()
    }
  })
  
  # Helper to retrieve candidate indices from user_star or test_idx
  get_candidate_indices <- function(id, username) {
    query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM user_star WHERE user_id='", username,
                    "' AND kepler_id=", id, ";")
    query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    if(nrow(query_result) == 0) {
      query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM test_idx WHERE id=", id, ";")
      query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    }
    if(nrow(query_result) > 0) {
      return(list(starts = query_result$start, ends = query_result$end))
    }
    return(list(starts = 0, ends = 0))
  }
  
  starts_ends_kplr_id <- eventReactive(input$kplr_id, {
    username <- user_info()$name
    id <- as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                          pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
    return(get_candidate_indices(id, username))
  })
  
  starts_ends_customize <- eventReactive(input$customize, {
    username <- user_info()$name
    id <- as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                          pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
    return(get_candidate_indices(id, username))
  })
  
  starts_ends_reset <- eventReactive(input$reset, {
    id <- as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                          pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
    query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM test_idx WHERE id=", id, ";")
    query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    if(nrow(query_result) > 0) {
      return(list(starts = query_result$start, ends = query_result$end))
    }
    return(list(starts = 0, ends = 0))
  })
  
  # Reactive state for zoom boundaries
  zoom_state <- reactiveValues(xlim = NULL)
  
  # Reset zoom when a different star is selected
  observeEvent(input$kplr_id, {
    zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
  })
  
  # Zoom into current brush selection
  observeEvent(input$zoom_brush, {
    if(!is.null(input$trainPlot_brush)) {
      st <- floor(max(1, input$trainPlot_brush$xmin))
      en <- ceiling(input$trainPlot_brush$xmax)
      if(en > st + 3) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(st, en)
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Zoom in (+50%)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_in, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(file) && file.exists(file)) {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      tot_len <- length(split_res$y_test)
      cur_lim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, tot_len) else zoom_state$xlim
      mid <- (cur_lim[1] + cur_lim[2]) / 2
      half <- (cur_lim[2] - cur_lim[1]) / 4
      if(half >= 3) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(floor(max(1, mid - half)), ceiling(min(tot_len, mid + half)))
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Zoom out (-50%)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_out, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(file) && file.exists(file)) {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      tot_len <- length(split_res$y_test)
      cur_lim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, tot_len) else zoom_state$xlim
      mid <- (cur_lim[1] + cur_lim[2]) / 2
      half <- (cur_lim[2] - cur_lim[1])
      new_st <- max(1, floor(mid - half))
      new_en <- min(tot_len, ceiling(mid + half))
      if(new_st <= 1 && new_en >= tot_len) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
      } else {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(new_st, new_en)
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Reset zoom to full light curve
  observeEvent(input$zoom_reset, {
    zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
  })
  
  # Helper to load/generate and save plot on demand
  render_star_plot <- function(kplr_id_val, custom_indices = NULL) {
    if(!credentials()$user_auth || is.null(kplr_id_val) || kplr_id_val == "") return(NULL)
    
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = kplr_id_val, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    
    out_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    plot_file <- file.path(plots_dir, paste0(out_base, "_test_plot.png"))
    
    raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
    cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
    split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
    y_test <- split_res$y_test
    x_test <- split_res$x_test
    test_vec <- as.vector(y_test)
    
    # Model inference (or load cached model)
    mdl_candidates <- c(
      file.path("trained_models", paste0(out_base, ".hdf5")),
      file.path("../trained_models", paste0(out_base, ".hdf5")),
      file.path("trained_models", "global_conv1d_autoencoder.hdf5"),
      file.path("../trained_models", "global_conv1d_autoencoder.hdf5")
    )
    valid_mdl <- mdl_candidates[file.exists(mdl_candidates)][1]
    
    y_pred <- array(0, dim = dim(y_test))
    if(!is.na(valid_mdl) && file.exists(valid_mdl) && requireNamespace("keras", quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        model <- keras::load_model_hdf5(valid_mdl)
        y_pred <- predict(model, x_test, verbose = 0)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
    
    # Ensure static plot file is saved for disk cache if not already existing
    if(!file.exists(plot_file)) {
      detected_cands <- save_plot(y_pred = y_pred, y = y_test, out_file = plot_file)
      star_id <- as.integer(gsub("^kplr([0-9]+).*", "\\1", out_base))
      if(nrow(detected_cands) > 0 && is.finite(star_id)) {
        detected_cands$id <- star_id
        detected_cands <- detected_cands[, c("id", "start", "end")]
        existing <- tryCatch({
          dbGetQuery(db_conn, paste0("SELECT count(*) FROM test_idx WHERE id=", star_id, ";"))[1, 1]
        }, error = function(e) 0)
        if(is.na(existing) || existing == 0) {
          dbWriteTable(db_conn, "test_idx", detected_cands, append = TRUE)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Compute anomaly mask
    if(!is.null(custom_indices)) {
      idx_mask <- rep(FALSE, length(test_vec))
      if(length(custom_indices$starts) > 0 && any(custom_indices$starts > 0)) {
        for(j in seq_along(custom_indices$starts)) {
          st <- custom_indices$starts[j]
          en <- min(custom_indices$ends[j], length(test_vec))
          if(st > 0 && en >= st) idx_mask[st:en] <- TRUE
        }
      }
    } else {
      det_res <- detect_transit_candidates(y_pred = y_pred, y = y_test)
      idx_mask <- det_res$is_anomaly
    }
    
    # Determine xlim and dynamic ylim for active zoom
    xlim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, length(test_vec)) else zoom_state$xlim
    sub_indices <- max(1, xlim[1]):min(length(test_vec), xlim[2])
    sub_flux <- test_vec[sub_indices]
    
    if(length(sub_flux) > 0 && any(is.finite(sub_flux))) {
      fl_min <- min(sub_flux, na.rm = TRUE)
      fl_max <- max(sub_flux, na.rm = TRUE)
      pad <- max(0.05 * (fl_max - fl_min), 0.001)
      ylim <- c(fl_min - pad, fl_max + pad)
    } else {
      ylim <- NULL
    }
    
    # Render interactive plot supporting zoom and brush
    title_str <- paste("Kepler Light Curve -", out_base,
                       if(!is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) sprintf("[Zoomed: %d - %d]", xlim[1], xlim[2]) else "")
    
    col_vec <- ifelse(idx_mask, "red", "black")
    plot(x = seq_along(test_vec), y = test_vec, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
         col = col_vec, pch = 20, cex = if(!is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) 0.9 else 0.5,
         ylab = "Normalized Flux", xlab = "Cadence Index",
         main = title_str)
    
    pred_vec <- as.vector(y_pred)
    if(length(pred_vec) == length(test_vec)) {
      lines(x = seq_along(pred_vec), y = pred_vec, col = "dodgerblue", lwd = 1.5)
    }
    
    legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Light Curve", "Transit Candidate Dip", "Autoencoder Baseline"),
           col = c("black", "red", "dodgerblue"), pch = c(20, 20, NA), lty = c(NA, NA, 1),
           lwd = c(NA, NA, 2), bg = "white")
  }
  
  observeEvent(input$kplr_id, {
    output$trainPlot <- renderPlot({
      render_star_plot(input$kplr_id)
    })
  })
  
  user_info <- reactive({
    return(credentials()$info)
  })
  
  output$welcome <- renderText({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    return(glue("Welcome {user_info()$name}"))
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$customize, {
    username <- user_info()$name
    id <- as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                          pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
    delete_query <- paste0("DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id='", username,
                           "' AND kepler_id=", id)
    dbExecute(db_conn, delete_query)
    insert_query <- paste0("INSERT INTO user_star VALUES ('", username,
                           "', ", id, ", 0, 0);")
    dbExecute(db_conn, insert_query)
    output$trainPlot <- renderPlot({
      custom_idx <- list(starts = 0, ends = 0)
      render_star_plot(input$kplr_id, custom_indices = custom_idx)
    })
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    username <- user_info()$name
    id <- as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                          pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
    delete_query <- paste0("DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id='", username,
                           "' AND kepler_id=", id)
    dbExecute(db_conn, delete_query)
    output$trainPlot <- renderPlot({
      render_star_plot(input$kplr_id)
    })
  })
  
  output$planet_page <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    return(fluidPage(
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          plotOutput("trainPlot", brush = brushOpts(id = "trainPlot_brush", direction = 'x'), height = "520px")
        )
      ),
      br(),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          div(style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 15px;",
            bsButton("zoom_brush", label = " Zoom to Selection", icon = icon("search-plus"), style = "primary"),
            bsTooltip(id = "zoom_brush", title = "Zoom into the range highlighted with the brush", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),
            
            bsButton("zoom_in", label = " Zoom In (+)", icon = icon("plus"), style = "info"),
            bsTooltip(id = "zoom_in", title = "Zoom in by 50%", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),
            
            bsButton("zoom_out", label = " Zoom Out (-)", icon = icon("minus"), style = "info"),
            bsTooltip(id = "zoom_out", title = "Zoom out by 50%", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),
            
            bsButton("zoom_reset", label = " Reset Zoom", icon = icon("arrows-alt"), style = "default"),
            bsTooltip(id = "zoom_reset", title = "Reset zoom to full light curve", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),
            
            span(style = "margin-left: 15px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),
            
            bsButton("customize", label = "Customize", icon = icon("edit"), style = "warning"),
            bsTooltip(id = "customize", title = "Create a fresh user copy of light curve with blank exoplanet tags", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),
            
            bsButton("reset", label = "Reset Tags to Model", icon = icon("undo"), style = "danger"),
            bsTooltip(id = "reset", title = "Remove user copy and restore model-based exoplanet tags", placement = "top", trigger = "hover")
          )
        )
      )
    ))
  })
  
  output$login_page <- renderUI({
    if(!credentials()$user_auth) {
      return(
        tabBox(tabPanel("Login", shinyauthr::loginUI(id = "login",
                                                     title = "Login to access exoplanet dashboard")),
               tabPanel("Signup", fluidPage(
                 fluidRow(
                   textInput(inputId = "user", label = "Username"),
                   textInput(inputId = "name", "Name"),
                   textInput(inputId = "password", label = "Password"),
                   selectInput(inputId = "permissions", label = "Permissions", choices = c("admin", "standard"), selected = "standard"),
                   actionButton(inputId = "signup", label = "Signup", icon = icon("user-plus")),
                   uiOutput("error")
                 )))))
    }
  })
})

```
